handoff.title: Where training lives
intro: This workbook does not program workouts.
GZCL owns: exercise selection · sets, reps and load progression · warm-ups · mobility and plyometrics · conditioning programming
This workbook owns: the targets you are executed against — body-fat band · protein targets · calorie guidance · cardio dose · recovery rules · the measurement loop

Deloads: the cadence is a recovery rule this workbook owns; the easier week itself is GZCL's to program. Call for one when the measurement log shows sleep short and resting HR climbing for a fortnight, not because the calendar says so.
